notes.title: My next game FLESH MADE FEAR is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316350/Flesh_Made_Fear/][b]PLAY THE DEMO HERE[/b][/url]

Hey everyone, 

it's Michael from Tainted Pact Games! 

After years of crafting indie horror experiences like Terror at Oakheart, Suffer the Night, and more, I'm beyond excited to announce the launch of my latest project—Flesh Made Fear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852736/8b0318eba3036d957e527245c1b8ae264a7f70c2.png[/img]

This game is a love letter to the PSX-era survival horror games we all know and love. Drawing inspiration from the classic Resident Evil trilogy, you'll step into the boots of a Reaper Intervention Platoon member, sent to take down the deranged Victor "The Dripper" Ripper, whose twisted experiments have transformed a quiet town into a nightmare.

Check out some Gameplay:

[previewyoutube=GkAGqReHXR8;full][/previewyoutube]

And the Trailer (posted by IGNːsteamhappyː) : 

[previewyoutube=1Woh2tJEDCE;full][/previewyoutube]

I need YOUR help to make this game everything it can be! With your support, I’ll be able to:

[list]
[*] Add high-quality cutscenes and voice acting
[*] Expand the world with more levels, monsters, and weapons
[*] Polish the controls and camera systems for a better experience
[*] Create branching narratives for more replayability
[*] Bring the game to current-gen consoles!
[/list]

Check out the Kickstarter now and help bring Flesh Made Fear to life! 🔪💀

👉 [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taintedpactgames/flesh-made-fear]Support on Kickstarter![/url]

Thank you for all your support!

Michael

notes.title: Suffer The Night - Available now!
notes.content:
[h3]SUFFER THE NIGHT is out now![/h3]

In the game, you take the role of Stacey Liden, a horror illustrator, who finds herself alone in a secluded cabin during a violent storm. During the storm, she receives a mysterious envelope with a floppy disk inside. She decides to put it into her old Eldrixon computer and begins playing. As she progresses through the terror of the text-based adventure, a mysterious and threatening stranger visits her. His only demand is: 'finish the game, Stacey!' And as she continues playing the game, the strange and horrifying things within the game begin leaking into the real world... Stacey begins to Suffer the Night!

[h3]Are you ready to find out, what the stranger's game is about?[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Sa0WH2kWPbg;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Suffer The Night[/b] bleeds together campy 80s slasher vibes with the familiar feel of anxiety-inducing first-person survival horror, with the added bonus of classic dungeon crawler gameplay.

[b]Suffer The Night is available now with a limited-time launch discount of 20 %![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176850/Suffer_The_Night/?utm_source=SteamNews&utm_campaign=outnow

You can also get the Dimensional Horror Bundle, which includes DreadXPs "Mirror Forge", as well as Suffer The Night!

[h3]Features of Suffer the Night:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Truly a “First-Person” Horror:[/b] After surviving the first chapter of Mr. Top’s “game within a game”, the real terror begins. Forces beyond comprehension have transported you INTO the grotesque game world, giving a new meaning to “survival horror”. 
[*] [b]Horror Beyond Comprehension:[/b] A highlight of this title is the text-based dungeon crawler “game within a game” filled with grisly scenarios and vivid descriptions of the atrocities wherein. Players will need to flex their old-school gaming muscles to progress within the stories, both inside the Eldrixon and out.
[*] [b]Don’t Let Him In:[/b] While playing through the floppy disk game, the mysterious figure who delivered it isn’t shy about making his presence known. Be sure to address any…interruptions…he causes, or suffer the consequences. 
[*] [b]A Chilling Combination:[/b] Suffer the Night expertly weaves two genres of horror games into one, balancing the chilling anxiety of the text-based adventure with the dread of first-person survival horror
[/list]

notes.title: Suffer The Night releases in April + New Screenshots!
notes.content:
Are you brave enough to [b]Suffer The Night[/b]?
On April 17th, you will be able to take the role of Stacey Liden, a painter who specializes in horror illustrations in her isolated woods-bound cabin. On a rainy evening, you receive a mysterious envelope, which contains a floppy disk. You boot it up on your computer and start playing the game, and after you progress in the text-based adventure, you get visited by a mysterious and threatening stranger. All he wants you to do, is finishing the game! But the further you play, the more it seems like the game and the reality are merging. Can you survive?

The year is 1989. Darkness has descended upon Sleepy Woods as a powerful and terrifying storm ravages the county. As lightning strikes, an ominous envelope appears at your front door: The gateway to your nightmares. 
Experience a bone-chilling blend of nostalgia and fear as you delve into the dark world of Suffer the Night. Can you escape the pale man's grasp, or will you fall victim to the horrors within?

notes.title: Suffer the Night brings an eerie mix of 1st person horror & textbased terror!
notes.content:
[i][b]The Ominous Demonic Entity Outside Your Door Just Wants You to Play Their Cursed Game. Go on then, Play it! What’s the Worst that Could Happen?[/b][/i]

Brace yourself for a night of terror and delicious cruelty, as we, German indie publisher [i][b]Assemble Entertainment[/b][/i], together with indie dev [i][b]Tainted Pact[/b][/i], are kicking off 2023 with a bang-or a scream- by stepping into the world of horror with our newest title: [b]Suffer the Night[/b]. 

A unique horror experience from developer [i][b]Tainted Pact[/b][/i] that blends first-person survival horror with the vibe of 80s slasher flicks, [b]Suffer the Night[/b] creates a dread-inducing atmosphere with a gripping narrative and jumpscares a’plenty. 
Coming to PC via Steam later this year, [b]Suffer the Night[/b] invites you to keep out evil incarnate by playing his wicked game—literally.   

[h3]Watch the development trailer: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=T8uMQx_Q8BA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Suffer the Night[/h3]
[u][b]The Story[/b][/u]
In [b]Suffer the Night[/b], players take on the role of [i]Stacey Liden[/i], a painter who specializes in horror illustrations in her isolated woods-bound cabin. After receiving an envelope containing a mysterious floppy disk, [i]Stacy[/i] boots it up on her old Eldrixon personal computer and begins playing. As she progresses through the terror of the text-based adventure, she’s visited by a mysterious and threatening stranger, urging her to finish the game. The strange and horrifying things within the game begin leaking into the real world…will [i]Stacey[/i] survive, or will she suffer the night? Only one thing is for certain: [b]don’t let him get in[/b].

[h3]Features of Suffer the Night: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Horror Beyond Comprehension:[/b] A highlight of this title is the text-based dungeon crawler “game within a game” filled with grisly scenarios and vivid descriptions of the atrocities wherein. Players will need to flex their old-school gaming muscles to progress within the stories, both inside the Eldrixon and out.
[*] [b]Don’t Let Him In:[/b] While playing through the floppy disk game, the mysterious figure who delivered it isn’t shy about making his presence known. Be sure to address any…interruptions…he causes, or suffer the consequences. 
[*] [b]A Chilling Combination:[/b] Suffer the Night expertly weaves two genres of horror games into one, balancing the chilling anxiety of the text-based adventure with the dread of first-person survival horror.[/list]


[h1]Suffer the Night has a planned release set for 2023. 
A free demo is now available to play on Steam — try the game now, if you dare![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176850/Suffer_The_Night/
